text:
maria: heads up — hetero-nightly is red, a bunch of h100 shards failed with OOM + some kernel errors. seen in two different images. anyone already digging?
raj: saw it, triaging now. looks like driver mismatch on some nodes (535 vs 540) and also a spike in alloc failures.
ci-bot: nightly/hetero-gpu #482 failed (task: warmup) — first failure: CUDA error 65 (launch timeout) on node h100-27; subsequent failures: cudaMalloc retries -> out of memory allocating 3.2 GiB; XID 31 logged. full job: https://ci.internal/jobs/482
alice: can we narrow to a shard set? which test is flaking?
raj: warmup/warmup_smoke and quant-attention tests. failing quicker on long-seq cases. repro locally on a single H100 with seq=4096 gives the same allocation failure.
sam: I'll attempt a canary rerun on a pinned-driver pool. if it passes there it's likely driver skew. planning: rerun 10 jobs pinned to driver 540 and 10 pinned to 535 to compare.
maria: sounds good. also post the minimal logs we have here so infra can check kernel messages.
raj: pasted relevant lines below:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (31): Ch 00000000, PID 4321, dqm 00000002, Replica: 0
[ 1234.568012] cuda: failed to allocate 3421737472 bytes: out of memory
[ 1234.568900] nvidia: kernel module tainted
```
alice: FYI we've seen similar OOMs when jobs landed on nodes with older driver + different libcuda ABI. could be a subtle PTX JIT fallback that's using more memory.
infra-bot: scheduled canary pool: hetero-canary-540 at 1766005600, hetero-canary-535 at 1766005605. autoscaler will pin gpu image to `redwood/inference:prod-2026-03-10`.
sam: started the targeted reruns: commands I used:
```
# run subset pinned to driver 540
cictl rerun --job=nightly/hetero-gpu --shards=warmup_smoke,quant-attention --pool=hetero-canary-540 --parallel=2
# run subset pinned to driver 535
cictl rerun --job=nightly/hetero-gpu --shards=warmup_smoke,quant-attention --pool=hetero-canary-535 --parallel=2
```
maria: thanks. if 535 fails & 540 passes, we should consider pinning new images to 540 for now and open a driver-compat ticket to investigate upstream.
raj: also adding a short repro script for anyone wanting to reproduce locally -- use the test harness with smaller batch and seq=4096: `./tools/run_warmup --model=gptx --seq=4096 --batch=1 --device=0`
alice: pinging @infra-eng in case kernel logs need collection or node quarantine.
raj: update — first 540 canary passed 8/8, 535 canary failed 3/8, failing shard shows same cudaMalloc OOM + Xid 31. looks driver-related.
ci-bot: created issue #INF-1972: "hetero-nightly: driver skew causing h100 warmup OOM/Xid31" and linked failing jobs.
sam: I'm going to kick off a bisect across recent driver rollouts: will spin up small fleet with drivers [532, 535, 538, 540] and run the warmup_smoke to see where regression appears. ETA ~2h.
maria: awesome — thanks. leave notes here with bisect results and any node IDs that are consistently bad. i'll coordinate release pin if needed. :thumbsup:
raj: thanks all, marking this thread for follow-up. sam if you need any help with repro scripts ping me.
sam: kicked off bisect at 1766007000, will post interim results.
maria: reminder to set `REDWOOD_GPU_WARMUP_DEBUG=1` on reruns to capture kv cache traces if we need deeper traces.
sam: noted, enabling that for next batch.
maria: closing the loop — if 540 remains stable we'll hold image pin and create rollout plan.
